Frequently asked questions

SOZYN helps candidates present their career information and helps recruiters make informed employment decisions. Candidates declare, employers respond, and recruiters decide.

What is SOZYN’s business intent?

SOZYN connects jobseekers, employers and recruiters through candidate-declared career information and employer-supplied employment responses. Its aim is to help recruiters review relevant candidates and help candidates present their history.

What is the Jobseeker Board?

The Jobseeker Board is the planned workspace for personal and career profiles, résumés, employment history, verification requests and job applications.

What is Employer Suite?

Employer Suite is the planned workspace for authorised organisation representatives to manage recruitment and respond to employment-confirmation requests.

Who confirms employment information?

Candidates declare their employment history. Selected past or current employers respond. SOZYN facilitates and presents the available information rather than conducting on-site checks.

Does verified status guarantee a job?

No. Verification supports review and shortlisting. Recruiters consider relevant skills, experience, availability and permitted employer responses and make their own hiring decisions.

Why is registration needed to apply?

When the application service is enabled, Jobseeker Board registration will link an application to the candidate’s profile and relevant information shared with the selected employer.

How are yearly premiums related to verification?

Under the planned model, an active yearly premium and the applicable employer-confirmation requirements maintain active badge eligibility. Payment alone cannot approve employment history. Final pricing and renewal terms will be shown before purchase.

How can I get help or contact SOZYN?

Use the Contact page for phone, email and WhatsApp options, or visit assist.sozyn.co.in. Never share your passcode with support. Registration and authentication are not connected in this preview.
